findings.desc: CHK-001:happy:0 and userSees require dispatch_reassign with the explicit worker role `lattice-implementer`, but the smoke evidence in packages/main/src/tasks/dispatch-run-smoke.ts uses and asserts `implementation-worker` instead (lines 767, 774, 784, 793). This proves generic role propagation but does not cover the canonical/user-visible role named in the verificationIntent, so the claimed coverage for explicit worker-role reassignment is incomplete.

dispatch_reassign is intended for accepted/completed worker dispatches, but reassignDispatch reads the previous record and immediately prepares a follow-up without checking resolveEffectiveStatus(previous) or local receipt acceptance. The text renderer then reports `Worker reassignment ready` without surfacing previous status, and dispatch-run-smoke explicitly proves reassignment from an unrun prepared dispatch with no receipt succeeds (unconstrainedPrepared at dispatch-run-smoke.ts:816-822). This can turn an incomplete/failed/diagnostic dispatch into a fresh ready worker assignment, misleading operators and violating CHK-001 completed-worker semantics. Require previous status/receipt acceptance or downgrade the output with an explicit non-completed warning and matching tests.
